# Sirach Chapter 43 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 43 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_043_page_001.jpg

---

43:1 The pride of the heavenly heights is the clear firmament; the appearance of heaven is in a vision of glory.

43:2 The sun, when it appears, proclaims as it rises: a marvelous instrument, the work of the Most High.

43:3 At noon it dries up the land, and who can withstand its burning heat?

43:4 A man stoking a furnace works in burning heat, but the sun burns the mountains three times as much; breathing out fiery vapors and shooting out gleaming beams, it blinds the eyes.

43:5 Great is the Lord who made it; and at his command it speeds on its way.

43:6 Also the moon, in all things according to its season, provides a marker of times and a sign of the world.

43:7 From the moon is the sign of feast days, a light that wanes when it has reached its full.

43:8 The month is named after the moon, growing wondrously in its changing; a military instrument in the heights above, shining out in the firmament of heaven.

43:9 The beauty of heaven, the glory of the stars, an ornament giving light in the highest places of the Lord.

43:10 At the word of the Holy One they will stand in judgment, and they do not grow weary at their watches.

43:11 Look upon the rainbow and bless its maker; it is exceedingly beautiful in its splendor.

43:12 It encircles the heaven with its glorious arc, and the hands of the Most High have stretched it out.

43:13 By his command he sends the snow, and he speeds the lightnings of his judgment.

43:14 Therefore the treasure houses are opened, and the clouds fly out like birds.

43:15 In his might he makes the clouds firm, and the hailstones are broken to pieces.

43:16 The mountains are shaken at the sound of him; and the south wind, the whirlwind of his might.

43:17 The voice of his thunder makes the earth writhe, the storm of the north and the whirlwind; as birds settling down he sprinkles the snow, and its descent is like the alighting of locusts.

43:18 The eye marvels at the beauty of its whiteness, and the heart is astonished at its raining down.

43:19 He also pours out frost upon the earth like salt, and when it is frozen it becomes bristling points.

43:20 The cold north wind blows, and ice is formed on the water; it settles on every pool of water, and the water puts on a coat of armor.

43:21 It devours the mountains and burns the wilderness, and scorches fresh grass like fire.

43:22 A sudden cloudburst heals all these; a dew coming from heat relieves.

43:23 By his planning he has stilled the deep, and planted islands in it.

43:24 Those who sail the sea tell of its dangers, and when we hear it with our ears we are astonished.

43:25 For in it are his marvelous works, strange and various creatures, all kinds of living things and the great sea monsters.

43:26 Because of him his messenger succeeds, and by his word all things hold together.

43:27 We could say more, but we could never say enough; let the final word be: he is the all.

43:28 Where shall we find the strength to praise him? For he is greater than all his works.

43:29 The Lord is awesome, exceedingly great, and his power is marvelous.

43:30 When you praise the Lord, exalt him as much as you can; for he will surpass even that. When you exalt him, redouble your strength, do not weary, for you cannot reach the end.

43:31 Who has seen him and can describe him? And who can praise him as he is?

43:32 Many things greater than these remain hidden, for we have seen but few of his works.

43:33 For the Lord made all things, and to the godly he has granted wisdom.
